They are among the finest groups of [[Alliance]] soldiers based in [[Kalimdor]] and it is their duty to uphold the laws of the Alliance.[[Captain Garran Vimes#Quotes]] ==History== ===Third War=== They were the remnants of the [[Human Expedition]] led by [[Jaina Proudmoore]]: former [[Alliance of Lordaeron]] units from various expeditionary forces such as the [[Stromgarde Brigade]] and [[Lordaeron Corps]]. During the occupation of Theramore by the [[Kul Tiras (kingdom)|Kul Tiran]] forces of [[Daelin Proudmoore]], the Theramore Guard was forced into service and fought against the [[Horde]] attackers. A Blaze of Glory - Theramore Guard barracks.jpg|Theramore Guard structures in the aftermath of the Third War. A Blaze of Glory - Theramore Guard ships.jpg|Docked Theramore Guard boats. ===Cycle of Hatred=== The Theramore Guard was on high alert when the actions of the [[Burning Blade clan|Burning Blade cult]] pit the nations of [[Theramore]] and [[Orgrimmar (faction)|Durotar]] against each other. Theramore's military investigated the activities of the cult, and [[Kristoff|Chamberlain Kristoff]] sent more than twenty boats and than four hundred soldiers to reinforce [[Northwatch Hold]],''[[Cycle of Hatred]]'', chapter 17 including the city's [[Elite Guard]].''[[Cycle of Hatred]]'', chapter 13 They all clashed against [[Burx]]'s own [[orc]]ish army at Northwatch. ===World of Warcraft=== The Theramore Guard is known for the exceptional training of its [[warrior]]s,[[Captain Evencane#Quotes]] and counts many [[marine]]s among its ranks. [[Adjutant Tesoran]] keeps track of all the records for the Guard, from personnel to their equipment.{{Alliance}} [38] [[Daelin's Men]] Though it is a struggle to maintain these outposts in the swamps, the Guard also occupies several defensive watchtowers through Dustwallow Marsh, even if they had to abandon [[Lost Point]].{{Alliance}} [38] [[The Deserters (1)]] At the beginning of every month, the marines from [[Kul Tiras (kingdom)|Kul Tiras]] all get paid and usually leave Theramore for somewhere else. A lot of them go to [[Menethil Harbor]] to womanize, carouse, and just have a good time.{{Alliance}} [33] [[The Missing Diplomat (13)]] The Theramore Guard is still seeking the exact location of the [[ogre]] settlement of [[Brackenwall Village|Brackenwall]], its [[Theramore Infiltrator|infiltrators]] doing their best to find it.{{Alliance}} [36] [[The Missing Diplomat (15)]] Unhappy with the way
